subject.title: Support compat reasoning levels for thinking xhigh

question: Should OpenClaw make `supportedReasoningEfforts`, `reasoningEffortMap`, and the Responses `supportsReasoningEffort` switch a supported public compat contract for configured OpenAI-compatible providers?
rationale: The implementation is bounded, but it changes the long-lived meaning of provider configuration and determines whether unsupported provider levels should remain hidden or become opt-in through config metadata.

options.title: Approve the scoped compat contract
options.body: Merge after confirming the documented rule that explicit supported labels control exposure and maps only translate a supported level.

options.title: Keep capability provider-owned
options.body: Reject or narrow the generic config contract and require individual bundled or external providers to own their reasoning-level policy.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped compat contract
recommendation.body: Merge after confirming the documented rule that explicit supported labels control exposure and maps only translate a supported level.

likelyOwner.reason: The earlier merged configured-xhigh work is the closest established ownership signal for this compatibility decision.
